description: Create a new surface mesh by slicing through the 3D model.

keywords.name: by-plane
keywords.syntax: by-plane [range] {origin <v> | normal <v> | slot <s> | gradation-surface <f> | use-hidden-zones | use-null-zones | to-grid-file <s> | to-geometry <s> | to-sketch <s>}
keywords.description: Slice through the model with a plane to create a new surface mesh. The plane is defined by an origin point and a normal vector. Options: origin <v>: Defines the origin of the plane.; normal <v>: Defines the normal vector of the plane.; slot <s>: Defines the slot in which the groups are used to split the surface mesh into different groups. If not supplied, the default slot is used.; gradation-surface <f>: Specify gradation f > 0 of the element sizes along the edges and inside the surface meshes. A value close to 0 leads to a more progressive variation. The default value is 0.5.; use-hidden-zones: If specified, hidden zones are included in the slice. By default, hidden zones are not included in the slice.; use-null-zones: If specified, null zones are included in the slice. By default, null zones are not included in the slice.; to-grid-file <s>: If specified, the surface mesh is written to f2grid file s . By default, the surface mesh is not written to file.; to-geometry <s>: If specified, the surface mesh is added to set s . By default, the surface mesh is not added to any set.; to-sketch <s>: If specified, the surface sketch is added to sketch set s . By default, the surface sketch is not added to any sketch set.

notes: Give to-geometry, to-sketch or to-grid-file to keep the result; with none of them no geometry set is created.
